From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: Stage refresh: tactical extracts for monthly forecast + leadership rollup

Team,

Time to run our month-end stage refresh for the leadership rollup. The ask: produce stage-level extracts for any open commits and borderline opportunities that could land this quarter. Key constraints:
- Deadline for extracts: EOD PT Tuesday (2026-11-23).
- Format: CSV pivoted by account, opportunity id, current stage, ARR, close date, primary owner, confidence (L/M/H), and last_activity_date.
- Attachments: I've dropped the "q4-stage-extracts.csv" template and the leadership-rollup-template.pptx in the shared drive link below.

Please ensure managers validate stage/close-date changes before you submit the extract. If an opportunity is being moved to "commit", add a one-line justification in the "notes" column.

I'll compile rollup slides Thurs morning and send to Vivek and execs for review. If you need a short call to align on gating rules, propose times—I'd like to avoid changing definitions in the middle of the roll.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEFghQ
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: q4-stage-extracts.csv (template), leadership-rollup-template.pptx

Thanks Aditya — on it. I'll task the reps in my pod to deliver extracts by EOD Tues. Two quick asks:
1) Please confirm whether "last_activity_date" can be at most 45 days; if older, mark as "stale" so we don't carry zombies into commit.
2) Can we lock the template columns? I've seen inconsistent columns trip the aggregator script.

I'll attach my pod's interim extract by Monday EOD for a quick sanity check.

Laura
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stage refresh: tactical extracts for monthly forecast + leadership rollup

Laura — good catches. Quick clarifications on gating:
- Commit criteria: opportunity with PO/contract signature intent + legal review started OR renewed contract negotiation w/ signed LOI.
- Close date tolerance for commit: within 30 days of quarter-end unless FP&A signoff.
- Last_activity_date: let's treat >60 days as stale for this scrub; please flag older than 60 days and include owner note.

I'll update the aggregator script to accept locked columns; Aditya, can you confirm I should enforce the column order I sent last quarter?

-K
